label: GO after an unrewarded S2 trial while committed to staying with a2 (mid-episode)
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires almost only at GO (99% of mass), never at D1, rarely at D2. It requires the previous trial to have been unrewarded (in_rew 0; 94% of mass after prev_reward 0, zero activity when the reward input is 1) and the previous trial to have reached S2 (essentially all after a2->S2 common; nothing after S1), with the agent again choosing a2 (stay) with a moderately strong a2 preference (policy logit a1-a2 between -8.9 and -4.4 holds 90% of mass; it does not fire when the agent prefers a1). Strongly restricted to the middle of the episode: silent in trials 0-14 and 70-99, peaking around trials 30-50, suggesting a slow time/context dependence. Value is moderately high (7.5-8.1) when active. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables plus the agent own policy logit; dev F1 0.70, mass recall 0.89. Remaining false positives are seemingly identical unrewarded-S2-then-stay GO steps where it stays silent, so precision is incomplete; without the episode-time window, precision drops to about 0.35.
